title: Fleet fuel capacity and usage

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 823238 (0x000c8fc6), HLP file offset 212411 (0x00033dbb), topic 95 'Using Fuel'
provenance.note: Fuel shared; capacity summed; usage depends on mass and engine.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 790469 (0x000c0fc5), HLP file offset 204218 (0x00031dba), topic 90 'Warp Speed'
provenance.note: Warp 1 free for standard engines; optimum speed.

setup.baseline: A fleet with known ships, mass and fuel.

procedure: Record capacity and usage at each warp speed.
Test free speed, ramscoop regeneration and fuel transfer.

documented: Fuel is shared by the fleet; capacity is the sum of ship capacities and usage is the sum of individual ship usage (documented-only).
Standard engines travel warp 1 without fuel; free/optimum speeds depend on engine type (documented-only).
